payload.summary: Railway deploys every main push without waiting for the required checks, so a red commit can be serving psychiatry.tools
payload.detail: Configure a Railway deployment gate on the app and worker services so they wait for pr-required to succeed on the main push. Why: the deploy and the post-merge CI run are two independent reactions to the same push, so 'CI passed' and 'what is live is tested' are different claims. Context: repo maturity review 2026-09-19; inferred from docs/deployment-architecture.md §6 (auto-deploy from main, rollback is a manual redeploy after the fact), NOT from a direct read of Railway settings. Owner: user (Railway dashboard, not code). Confidence: medium — the absence of a gate is inferred from docs; verify in the dashboard first. Depends on: nothing.
payload.source: session 2026-09-20 /ledger sweep — nine-agent repo maturity review
